items.title: Seamless agent upgrades
items.text: When the background session agent needs to update, it now refreshes lazily and non-destructively (on idle or as sessions naturally close), carrying your live sessions across safely instead of resetting them. If a session genuinely can't be carried over, you get an explicit confirmation first — never a silent reset.

items.title: Rich HTML in the markdown viewer
items.text: Markdown files that embed raw HTML now render it (safely sanitized via DOMPurify), so more documents display the way they're meant to.

items.title: Cleaner status banners
items.text: Table columns size to their bold-rendered width so labels no longer wrap mid-word; consecutive text lines and checkbox-led lists now get consistent spacing.

items.title: Correct shell in new panes
items.text: Splits, tabs, and windows now fall back to your login shell (not `/bin/sh` or a bare `/bin/zsh`), and persistent local panes no longer re-run the parent pane's command when opening a plain split.
